2026_05_DET_ARI.headline: Hutchinson targets Arizona’s rookie tackle as Lions seek defensive response
2026_05_DET_ARI.paragraph1: Detroit needs a cleaner defensive performance after giving up big plays to Carolina, while Jared Goff's passing production gives Arizona's secondary a different test. The Cardinals will turn to rookie Jayden Williams at left tackle after Paris Johnson Jr.'s injury, creating an immediate protection challenge against Aidan Hutchinson. Arizona can answer with quicker releases by Jacoby Brissett and targets for Trey McBride and Michael Wilson before Detroit's rush arrives; the Lions can counter with coverage rotations that shrink those early windows. Arizona must protect Brissett without abandoning the run, while Detroit needs pressure that does not leave easy completions.
2026_05_DET_ARI.model_rationale: Detroit can pressure Arizona’s altered offensive line, but must finish tackles and protect against quick passes. The Cardinals need efficient distribution and reliable protection to sustain drives.
